normal_queries.question: 统计各地区销售额
normal_queries.reference_sql: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM sales GROUP BY region

normal_queries.question: 统计各产品销量和销售额
normal_queries.reference_sql: SELECT product, SUM(quantity), ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM sales GROUP BY product

normal_queries.question: 查看月度销售趋势
normal_queries.reference_sql: SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7), ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM sales GROUP BY 1

normal_queries.question: 列出订单明细
normal_queries.reference_sql: SELECT order_date, region, product, quantity, amount FROM sales

normal_queries.question: 一共有多少订单，总销售额多少
华东地区的订单明细
normal_queries.reference_sql: SELECT order_date, region, product, quantity, amount FROM sales WHERE region='华东'

normal_queries.question: 华北每月销售额
normal_queries.reference_sql: SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7), ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM sales WHERE region='华北' GROUP BY 1

normal_queries.question: 华南各产品销售情况
normal_queries.reference_sql: SELECT product, SUM(quantity), ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM sales WHERE region='华南' GROUP BY product

normal_queries.question: 平均每笔订单金额是多少
华东的平均订单金额
normal_queries.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(amount),2) FROM sales WHERE region='华东'

normal_queries.question: 销售额最高的产品是哪个
normal_queries.reference_sql: SELECT product, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS t FROM sales GROUP BY product ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 1

normal_queries.question: 各地区订单数
normal_queries.reference_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM sales GROUP BY region

normal_queries.question: 按产品类别统计销售额
normal_queries.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(s.quantity), ROUND(SUM(s.amount),2) FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.product=s.product GROUP BY p.category

normal_queries.question: 各产品单价是多少
normal_queries.reference_sql: SELECT product, category, unit_price FROM products

normal_queries.question: 华北地区一共卖了多少钱
normal_queries.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM sales WHERE region='华北'
